title: [Safety Question/Discussion] Change in bolus wizard - 100% Bolus
symptom: A change in the Bolus Wizard causes the bolus percentage to be ignored (i.e., 100% is used) when CGM is not available, which could lead to users unintentionally delivering a 100% bolus instead of their usual lower percentage, potentially causing overdosing and serious hypos.
cause: The change in BolusWizard: if CGM is not available, the percentage is ignored and 100% is used. This is a deliberate design decision, but it may override user-set percentages without warning.
fix: The thread discusses that the behavior can be adjusted via Engineering mode, specifically the 'Old glycemia time threshold [min]' setting, which defaults to 16 minutes and can be changed. Additionally, users can manually change the percentage in the dialog. No code fix is proposed; the discussion suggests adding warnings or user-configurable defaults.
settings_changed: Old glycemia time threshold [min] → 16 (default, adjustable in Engineering mode)
evidence_quote: Engineering mode adds another entry below that, "Old glycemia time threshold [min]", with a default of 16 minutes and a minimum of 6 minutes.
